tools.name: github-list-issues
tools.title: List GitHub issues
tools.description: List the most recently updated issues in a GitHub repository, with their labels, author and comment count. Use when someone asks what is open, what changed recently, or whether an issue already exists before filing one.

repo.description: The repository as owner/name, e.g. acme/website

state.description: Which issues to include. Defaults to open

limit.description: How many issues to return. Defaults to 10

tools.name: github-create-issue
tools.title: Create a GitHub issue
tools.description: Open a new issue in a GitHub repository. Always confirm the repository, title and body with the person before calling this, and check with github-list-issues that it has not already been filed.

repo.description: The repository as owner/name, e.g. acme/website

title.description: A short summary of the problem or request

labels.description: Labels to apply. They must already exist in the repository
